# Multi-file fixtures

- `editable-sample.docx`, `transparent-sample.png`, and `photo-sample.jpg` are synthetic files generated by `node scripts/asset-fixtures.mjs`.
- `presentation-sample.pptx` and `legacy-presentation.ppt` are self-authored three-slide samples. Creator, company and last-editor metadata are anonymized by `scripts/sanitize-office-fixtures.mjs`. On a Windows machine with PowerPoint, regenerate them with `powershell.exe -NoProfile -File scripts/make-office-fixtures.ps1` after closing Office; the script applies anonymization automatically.
- `legacy-sample.doc` is LibreOffice's `changes-in-footnote.doc` interoperability regression fixture: <https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/master/sw/qa/extras/ww8import/data/changes-in-footnote.doc>. It is used only to verify importing a genuine legacy Word container. The upstream project applies its [MPL 2.0 / LGPLv3+ licensing](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/master/COPYING.MPL) to applicable files; the original fixture bytes are retained.

No user documents or notes are included in these samples.
